_comment: CRON-86: Spirit crane (灵鹤) — wetland bird, immortal companion. Spawns in marshes, river basins, and spirit herb hills. Canon note: the crane is a culturally-significant bird associated with Daoist cultivators; in 仙逆, cranes appear as immortal mounts and sect mascots. Weight 4 = uncommon (dignified creature, not a pest).
